summary: First iteration e2e test of Podosis static marketing site. Backend (/api/, /api/health, /api/contact POST/GET) fully functional with valid/invalid/persistence coverage. Frontend: all 13 routes render, invalid slugs redirect as expected, sticky WhatsApp visible on every route, mobile menu open/close works, service detail FAQ accordion expands, blog detail renders with cover image + content, contact form submits to backend and shows success (contact-success) and validates empty input (contact-error). Google Maps iframe present on home + /iletisim. Per-route SEO titles update via react-helmet-async (home title 'Elvankent Ayak Bakım Merkezi | Podosis', blog title contains article title).

issues: React console warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — a JSX image element is using lowercase `fetchpriority` attribute. Cosmetic dev-only warning, no user-facing impact. Find and rename to fetchPriority.

action_items: Optional: replace JSX attribute `fetchpriority` with camelCase `fetchPriority` on tags to silence React console warning (search src/ for fetchpriority).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to lifespan context manager (minor; still works).
CORS is wide-open (allow_origins='*') with allow_credentials=True — combination is ignored by browsers and could be tightened to the deployed frontend origin.
No rate limiting on /api/contact — public endpoint vulnerable to spam flooding Mongo; add basic throttle or captcha before production launch.
Contact list endpoint /api/contact (GET) is public and returns all submissions (PII: name, phone, message). Should be auth-gated or removed in production.
mock.js is ~680 lines. Fine for static content but consider splitting per concern (services, products, blog) if content grows.
Several pages likely >300 lines; monitor for 700-line threshold as features grow.
seed_data_creation: Contact messages created during tests prefixed with 'TEST_' (TEST_User, TEST_Persist, TEST_Playwright). These persist in MongoDB contact_messages collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_podosis_backend.py covers / , /health, and /contact (valid, invalid, persistence). Reuse it as regression. Frontend is Turkish static site — Home has title 'Elvankent Ayak Bakım Merkezi | Podosis'. Contact POST works against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/contact. Public URL: https://healthy-steps-13.preview.emergentagent.com. All interactive elements have data-testid (whatsapp-sticky-button, mobile-menu-open/close, contact-name-input/contact-phone-input/contact-message-input/contact-submit/contact-success/contact-error). Invalid slugs (e.g. /hizmetler/foo) correctly redirect to parent list page via <Navigate> components. Only outstanding issue is a React dev console warning about `fetchpriority` — not blocking.
